container: Colonialism severely disrupted indigenous communities worldwide by displacing populations, erasing languages and cultures, and imposing foreign systems of governance and religion. Land was seized, traditional ways of life destroyed, and indigenous people subjected to exploitation and violence. Generations suffered from loss of identity, intergenerational trauma, and systemic inequality. Many indigenous communities continue to fight for recognition, land rights, and cultural preservation, striving to reclaim their heritage and sovereignty in the face of enduring colonial legacies.
